title: Integrability of a composition of functions
summary: The paper deals with the Riemann and Lebesgue integrability of functions. Sufficient conditions and criteria are stated for the integrability of a composition of functions. Relevant counterexamples are constructed based on Cantor's perfect sets and the Cantor staircase function. The main tool of research is Lebesgue's criterion for Riemann integrability.
